skills.name: Puar
skills.description: Self: 15 Shield (expires after 3 turns). Becomes Spirit Ball for 3 turns | 1 Rand
skills.notes: "Points of damage" shield -- NOT destructible defense: this expires after 3 turns even if never hit (destructible defense only ever shrinks by absorbing damage; this is a temporary ward on top of that concept). Also turns this same skill into Spirit Ball for the next 3 of Yamcha's turns. Pure time-window transform, NOT a one-shot combo payoff like Tri-Beam: no unprime_skill here, so it stays "Spirit Ball" (usable more than once, subject to Spirit Ball's own cooldown) until the 3-turn window itself runs out, reverting back to Puar automatically. (3-turn shield duration is a judgment call matching the transform window -- tell me if you want it different.)

skills.name: Wolf Fang Fist
skills.description: Marks an enemy: if they attempt any skill on their next turn, it's countered and they take 20 Piercing Dmg. Hidden from the enemy | 1 Mar, 1 Rand
skills.notes: Pure setup/trap, no direct effect of its own: marks one enemy. If THEY attempt any skill on their next turn, it's blocked entirely and they take 20 piercing damage instead (see the counter-check in queue_move). Invisible -- the target gets no warning badge that they've been marked.

skills.name: Fake Death
skills.notes: Universal defensive skill (see Goku's afterimage_technique) -- same id/mechanic roster-wide, flavored here as Yamcha playing dead.
